original_answer:
To start a paw paw tree from seed, follow these steps:

1. Collect pollen from one paw paw tree using a paintbrush or something soft. Rub the flower of another tree to collect pollen. Note that each individual flower will only accept pollen from a flower from a genetically distinct individual tree.
2. Cut open a soft, ripe paw paw fruit to remove the paw paw seeds from the pulp. Set the paw paw seeds into a colander or wire basket. Rinse the paw paw seeds under cool tap water. Use a small brush, if necessary, to remove excess pulp from the seeds.
3. Place the bag containing the paw paw seeds into a refrigerator where the temperature is approximately 30 to 40 degrees Fahrenheit. Leave the bag in the refrigerator for approximately 90 days. Check on the contents of the bag at least once a week to make certain the sphagnum peat moss remains moist.
4. Once the seeds have germinated, transfer them to a pot. Place the potted pawpaw seed indoors near a window, or outdoors in a cold frame or on a lightly shaded porch. Choose a spot with at least six hours of direct sunlight daily.
5. Store the pawpaw seeds inside a paper bag away from heat and humidity until late winter, approximately two months before the last frost. Inspect the seeds, and discard any that appear damaged or rotten.

question: how to cook in oven a prime beef roast
context:
passage 1:Remove prime rib from refrigerator and allow the meat to come to room temperature, about 3 hours depending on the size of the roast. Preheat oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Line a roasting pan with aluminum foil. Unwrap the roast and place onto roasting pan; blot with paper towels. Sift together flour, pepper, salt, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, and celery seed into a small bowl. Coat the roast all over with the flour mixture. Roast in preheated oven until cooked to your desired degree of doneness; about 4 1/2 hours (20 minutes a pound) for medium-rare.

passage 2:To check the temperature of your oven, place an oven thermometer on the center rack and heat the oven for 15 minutes at 350 degrees F. If, after 15 minutes, the oven temperature reads higher or lower than your oven setting, adjust your oven setting for your prime rib baking and for all your future baking.

passage 3:Place the tray in the oven and roast for 1/2 hour. For the first half hour, the beef will cook at a higher temperature, which will give the outside of the beef a good sear. Make sure you remember to come back to the oven after 1/2 hour. Turn down the temperature to 225°F (107°C) and continue roasting.
original_answer:
To cook a prime beef roast in the oven, follow these steps:
1. Remove the prime rib from the refrigerator and allow it to come to room temperature, about 3 hours depending on its size.
2. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a roasting pan with aluminum foil.
3. Unwrap the roast and place it onto the roasting pan. Blot any excess moisture with paper towels.
4. In a small bowl, sift together flour, pepper, salt, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, and celery seed.
5. Coat the entire surface of the roast with the flour mixture.
6. Place the tray in the oven and roast for 1/2 hour at 425°F (220°C) to sear the beef.
7. After 1/2 hour, turn down the oven temperature to 225°F (107°C) and continue roasting for an additional 3 1/2 hours (or 20 minutes per pound) for medium-rare.
8. Check the temperature of your oven before starting to bake by placing an oven thermometer on the center rack and heating the oven for 15 minutes at 350°F. Adjust your oven setting accordingly if necessary.
9. Once the roast is cooked to your desired level of doneness, remove it from the oven and let it rest for at least 15-20 minutes before slicing and serving. Enjoy!

passage 1:AF-S is AF 'single'- your camera will focus on a fixed object when you press the AF button and will remain focused on that point for as long as you hold the button down.This is best for static subjects.AF-C is AF 'continuous' - the camera will focus on whatever is in the relevant AF points (depending on how you have your AF coverage set up) and will attempt to keep the subject in focus wherever it moves, whether that's towards/away from the camera or laterally.F-A is AF 'auto' and automatically switches between the two AF modes depending on what the subject is doing. passage 3:AF-C is continuous, when you focus on an object, holding it (half-)pressed, it will continue to try to keep whatever is in the focus areas in focus, whether you move or the subject moves, or you move the focus area to another subject.F-S is single, when you focus on one object and hold it (half-)pressed, it will keep the focus where it locked. To slow and tender cook a chuck roast in the oven, follow these steps:

1. Preheat the oven to 350°F.
2. Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.

5. Place the browned roast in a shallow baking pan with a wire rack on the bottom.

passage 3:Step By Step: 1  As soon as you get the NUC to your apiary, place in its permanent location with the entrance at the same place as the entrance to the hive will be. 2  Remove the block to the NUC entrance and wait at least 24 hours. original_answer:
To install a NUC of bees, follow these steps:

1. Place the NUC in its permanent location with the entrance at the same place as the entrance to the hive will be.
2. Wait for at least 24 hours for the bees to orient to the new location.
3. Once the bees have oriented, move the NUC to the side of the hive location and replace it with an empty nest box.
4. Gently smoke the entrance to the NUC.
5. Remove the top of the NUC and spritz the bees with a light sugar syrup.
6. If the NUC is packed with bees, add a second box on top of the nest box, preferably with some drawn comb frames. Add the inner cover (or Vivaldi cover) and sugar syrup. Add the hive top and reduce the hive entrance to 1 inch. You can increase to no more than 3 inches in a few weeks.

original_answer:
To make chocolate mirror glaze, follow these steps:

1. Soften the gelatin in cold water.
2. In a saucepan, bring the water and sugar to a boil on medium heat.
3. Once boiling, add the sifted cocoa powder and whisk until well combined.
4. Heat the heavy cream to a boil.
5. Pour the boiled cream into the cocoa sugar syrup and whisk until smooth.
6. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the chopped dark chocolate until melted.
7. Strain the mixture through a fine mesh strainer to remove any air bubbles.
8. Allow the chocolate mirror glaze to cool and store it in an airtight container in the fridge overnight.
9. Before using, warm the chocolate mirror glaze to a temperature around 110°F (44°C).
10. Strain the glaze again before using to ensure a smooth finish.

passage 1:Times Square: Why is this called a square? - See 40,709 traveler reviews, 25,021 candid photos, and great deals for New York City, NY, at TripAdvisor.

passage 2:Even lifelong New Yorkers may not be aware of its origins. Times Square stretches between Broadway and Seventh Avenue, and between West 42nd and West 47th Streets. A subway station at the corner of 42nd Street and Broadway marks the name. Longacre Square became Times Square once the New York Times built its headquarters there, moving from 41 Park Row in downtown Manhattan to their Gothic skyscraper (25 stories!) in January, 1905.

passage 3:Like Times Square, Herald Square is named after a prominent newspaper of the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, the New York Herald, which eventually merged with the New-York Tribune. Horace Greeley was the great editor of the Tribune.

The area was renamed Times Square in 1905 when the New York Times moved its headquarters to the Gothic skyscraper there. Similarly, Herald Square is named after another prominent newspaper, the New York Herald.

question: how to make cooked fresh beets from the garden
context:
passage 1:Beet Varieties. The most common garden beet is a deep ruby red in color, but yellow, white, and even candy-striped (with red and white concentric circles) are available in specialty markets. Sugar beets are used to make table sugar. The leaves of the beet plant are also edible.

passage 2:To boil beets, submerge them in boiling water until they are tender. You can cut the beets first or leave them whole to boil. For sautéed beets, slice or dice beets and sauté in a pan with oil until beets are tender. Season to taste.

passage 3:Fresh tops mean fresh beets. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Place rack in middle of oven. Wash and scrub the whole beets to clean off any dirt. Leave the beet whole unless you have some extra large ones (if extra large, cut in half). Trim off the stems (leafy tops) and ends of the beets. Reserve the beet leaves for a recipe using them. Beet Greens - How To Cook Fresh Beet Greens.
original_answer:
To make cooked fresh beets from the garden, you can follow these steps:

1. Wash and scrub the whole beets to clean off any dirt. Leave the beet whole unless you have some extra large ones (if extra large, cut in half). Trim off the stems (leafy tops) and ends of the beets.
2. Boil beets by submerging them in boiling water until they are tender. You can cut the beets first or leave them whole to boil. If you want to steam beets, cut them into 1/2-inch pieces and place them in a steamer basket with 2 inches of boiling water and cover. Cook them until they are tender.
3. Sauté beets by slicing or dicing them and sautéing them in a pan with oil until beets are tender. Season to taste.
4. Once the beets are cooked, peel off the skin using a vegetable peeler.
5. Serve the beets as a side dish or use them in a recipe of your choice.

Note: If you want to preserve the beet greens, you can blanch them in boiling water for 2 minutes, then shock them in ice water. Dry them thoroughly and store them in an airtight container in the fridge or freezer.

To clean tarnished jewelry at home, you can follow these steps:

For items that are merely dull, filmy or starting to discolor, mix a few drops of mild dish soap with warm water and dip in a soft cloth. Rub the jewelry, then rinse in cool water and buff with a cloth until dry.

To clean a diamond, use warm soapy water and a soft-bristle brush or old toothbrush. Rinse in cool water and pat dry with a soft cloth.

passage 1:Guide. A Lyme disease test detects antibodies to the Lyme disease bacteria Borrelia burgdorferi in the blood. Lyme disease bacteria are spread by certain kinds of ticks. Lyme disease can be hard to diagnose because its symptoms are similar to those of many other illnesses.

passage 3:A blood test for antibodies to the bacteria is the preferred test for the diagnosis of Lyme disease. However, if a person has central nervous system symptoms, such as meningitis, then IgM, IgG, and western blot testing may sometimes be performed on cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) .

question: how to remove the front tire on a harley davidson golf cart
context:
passage 1:Up for auction is a good used 3 wheel harley davidson golf cart front steering axle and hub assembly is in good working condition i have more parts of this cart listed if you have any questions just askno reservehappy bidding.

passage 2:SOURCE: removal of front wheel. First remove some air from the tire so that it will be able to make through the forks once its loose.

passage 3:SOURCE: removal of front wheel. First remove some air from the tire so that it will be able to make through the forks once its loose. standing in front of bike facing it. on your left side of wheel is a bolt at the axel that should be a large allen/hex head bolt loosen it to take pressure off of axel.
original_answer:
To remove the front tire on a Harley Davidson Golf Cart, follow these steps:

1. Remove some air from the tire so that it can be easily removed.
2. Stand in front of the bike and locate the bolt on the left side of the wheel at the axle. This bolt should be a large Allen/hex head bolt.
3. Loosen the bolt to relieve pressure on the axle.
4. Carefully remove the wheel by pulling it straight back towards you.
5. If needed, use a wrench or other tool to help remove the wheel.
6. Repeat the process for the rear wheel if necessary.

1. Draw a circle with a diameter of 6 inches for the base of the cone. Label this as the variable "b".
2. Draw another smaller circle within the first circle, centered at the top of the first circle. Label this as the variable "t".
3. Draw a vertical line from the center of the second circle downwards to the center of the first circle. Label this line as the variable "h".
4. Use the "Circle" tool in GeoGebra to draw a third smaller circle at the top of the second circle. This circle represents the top of the cone. Label this as the variable "w".
5. Use the "Line" tool in GeoGebra to connect the two circles representing the base of the cone and the top of the cone. This line represents the sides of the truncated cone.
6. Finally, use the "Line" tool in GeoGebra to connect the top of the cone to the bottom of the cone. This line represents the height of the truncated cone.

question: how to force removal of a printer in devices and printers
context:
passage 1:In summary, if you use the Print Manager or Printers folder to remove a printer or printer port, then close Print Manager or the Printers folder, stop and restart the Spooler Service.

passage 2:Step 2: Then click on Control Panel. Step 3: Then click on Hardware and Sound. Step 4: T hen clicking Printers. Step 5: Right-click the printer that you want to remove, and then click Delete. If you can't delete the printer, right-click it again, click Run as administrator, and then click Delete.

passage 3:Step 2: Remove the printer from the devices list. Remove printers and uninstall any Windows print drivers using Windows Devices and Printers. If your printer connects to the computer with a USB cable, disconnect the cable from the printer. Turn the printer off and on again, and make sure that it is in a ready state.
original_answer:
To force removal of a printer in devices and printers:
1. Use Print Manager or Printers folder to remove the printer or printer port.
2. Close Print Manager or the Printers folder.
3. Stop and restart the Spooler Service.
4. Go to Control Panel > Hardware and Sound > Printers.
5. Right-click the printer you want to remove and select Delete. If you cannot delete the printer, right-click it again, select Run as administrator, and then select Delete.
6. If the printer is connected to the computer via USB cable, disconnect it from the printer.
7. Turn off the printer and turn it back on again. Ensure that it is in a ready state.
8. Remove the printer from the devices list and any associated Windows print drivers.
regenerated_answer:

3. Disconnect the USB cable from the printer if it's connected to your computer.
4. Turn off the printer and turn it back on to ensure it's in a ready state.
5. Remove the printer from the devices list and any associated Windows print drivers.

To properly clean your hair, follow these steps:
